metadata.evidence_scope: explicit organization-level statements on confessional standards
metadata.modeling_rule: Only statements explicitly framed by the page as Jude 3 & the PCA's own beliefs are normalized here. The adjacent Firm Foundation Partnership endorsement is excluded from Jude 3 attribution.

positions.summary: Jude 3 & the PCA states that periodic review and renewal of commitment to the Westminster Standards is healthy, and describes the Standards as subordinate to Scripture while serving as a good and necessary summary of Bible doctrine.

Jude 3 & the PCA rejects time-bound critical methods, Critical Theory, pervasive interpretive pluralism, and other culturally approved critical tools as authorities for determining Bible doctrine or reviewing the confessional standards.

Jude 3 & the PCA rejects dismissing the Westminster Standards on the ground that their authors were seventeenth-century churchmen, characterizing that move as chronological snobbery and emphasizing the divines' sustained Scriptural study and collaboration.
positions.boundary: This record does not import the following Firm Foundation Partnership statement about strict adherence into Jude 3's organizational position.
